message.content:
False.

The reported COUNT_OF_PARTICIPANTS for Objective Response Rate (ORR) as Assessed by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) 1.1 was actually 9 participants, not 8. This is because out of the 9 participants, 1 had an Objective Response (CR+PR) and 8 had No Objective Response (SD+PD). Two patients were not evaluable for response, which is why the analysis population was 9 (9 - 2 = 7 evaluable participants, but the total is still reported as 9 in the context of the denominator).
